description.value: TL Etinqox Trading is a convenience store affiliated with the Tl'etinqox First Nation, one of the largest Tsilhqot'in communities in BC's central interior, located near Alexis Creek roughly an hour west of Williams Lake. Situated on Anahim Foothills Road in one of the most remote cycling corridors in the province, it represents a rare resupply point for cyclists on the Chilcotin plateau. The Nation's government website also lists a 'Chilcotin River Trading' at the same phone number, suggesting the store may have been rebranded or replaced.

No store-specific amenity information appears anywhere on the website, so all amenity fields remain null.
